rows.estimation_basis: No reference projects were provided. Estimates are built bottom-up from general engineering experience delivering HIPAA-compliant tele-health architectures, real-time WebRTC communications, and dual app-store deployments. Hours reflect the total delivery effort of a cross-functional human team including architecture, development, automated/manual testing, penetration testing, DevOps, project management, and post-launch stabilisation. Uncertainty is factored into the high-end bounds to accommodate compliance audits, App Store review cycles, and third-party BAA integrations.
